title: Agentic-AI-ready genome-wide poxvirus–host interaction screen refined by a protein language model
authors: Jacob Marcel Anter; Jason Mercer; Artur Yakimovich
one_liner_zh: 该文利用蛋白语言模型整合蛋白互作信息优化痘病毒-宿主全基因组筛选，虽涉及蛋白语言模型但核心是功能筛选而非蛋白质结构计算建模，算法可部分借鉴。
abstract: Recent mpox outbreaks highlight the necessity to understand the interactions between poxviruses and the human host. These can be discovered systematically through screening for host genes involved in infection at the single-cell level using RNA interference. However, off-target effects and assay noise obscure true gene-phenotype relationships, hampering the discovery of therapeutically relevant targets. Here, we show that integrating protein-protein interaction information derived from a protein language model boosts the discovery of vaccinia virus-host interactions. We propose ICARus – a positive-unlabelled read-out refinement framework to achieve this. Our approach enhances the identification of human genes with potential antiviral function. We provide the raw and refined read-outs of a genome-wide screen for vaccinia virus host factors as an agentic-AI-enabled community resource. Our findings provide a generalisable strategy for robust hit prioritisation in functional screens, accelerating discovery across complex biological systems.
abstract_zh: 近期猴痘疫情暴发凸显了理解痘病毒与人类宿主之间相互作用的必要性。这些相互作用可通过在单细胞水平上利用RNA干扰筛选参与感染的宿主基因来系统性地发现。然而，脱靶效应和检测噪声掩盖了真实的基因-表型关系，阻碍了治疗相关靶点的发现。在此，我们表明整合源自蛋白质语言模型的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用信息可增强牛痘病毒-宿主相互作用的发现。我们提出ICARus——一种正-未标记读出精炼框架以实现这一目标。我们的方法增强了对具有潜在抗病毒功能的人类基因的识别。我们提供了全基因组牛痘病毒宿主因子筛选的原始及精炼读出数据，作为代理式AI赋能的社区资源。我们的发现为功能筛选中稳健命中优先排序提供了一种通用策略，加速了复杂生物系统中的发现进程。
